headline: Exploring Wilton, Connecticut This Autumn
subhead: Historic parks, riverside walking trails, and two convenient Metro-North train stations.
caption: Wilton offers a scenic Fairfield County setting defined by historic character and expansive green space. October brings vibrant foliage across Weir Farm National Historical Park and along the crushed-stone paths of the Norwalk River Valley Trail. Wilton Center provides convenient local dining, shopping, and community spaces like Schenck's Island and Merwin Meadows. For getting around, Route 7 runs directly through town, alongside two stops on the Metro-North Danbury Branch at Wilton Station and historic Cannondale. Whether you are curious about local parks, transit options, or neighborhood layouts, reach out today to learn more about current real estate opportunities in Wilton.

hook: Wilton holds Connecticut's national historical park.
hook_say: Wilton gives you historic charm, direct train access, and incredible fall scenery.

scenes.label: Outdoors
scenes.title: Weir Farm National Park
scenes.detail: Weir Farm offers preserved painting studios, stone walls, and walking paths through historic woodlands.
scenes.say: I love walking the trails at Weir Farm when the fall foliage peaks.

scenes.label: Trails
scenes.title: Norwalk River Valley Trail
scenes.detail: The crushed-gravel trail connects Wilton Center to open spaces, passing ponds and wooded corridors.
scenes.say: You can hop on the trail right downtown for an easy autumn walk.

scenes.label: Downtown
scenes.title: Wilton Center Amenities
scenes.detail: Wilton Center features local dining, the public library, Schenck's Island park, and seasonal autumn displays.
scenes.say: Wilton Center puts daily essentials, independent shops, and peaceful riverfront green space together.

scenes.label: Transit
scenes.title: Commuter Rail Access
scenes.detail: Commuters utilize Wilton and Cannondale stations on the Metro-North Danbury Branch, plus Route 7 access.
scenes.say: Having two train stations right in town makes getting down toward the coast simple.
